insights.text: Their best players are jungle and support: **Señor Flausch** (Master 648 LP) and **Lord Steve** (Master 1,071 LP). Our bans go on Flausch.
Mid is their weak link: **WoFu Ven** is Diamond 2, 14-16 in his last 30 ranked games, and plays immobile control mages (Anivia, Viktor, Xerath, Ziggs, Veigar). Smette's first gank goes mid.
They win fast and lose long: their 8 wins took 29 min on average, their 7 losses 36 min (three of them 42+ min). Don't take early coin-flips; we're fine at 3 items.
Other teams banned **Elise** (8×) and **Jarvan IV** (5×) against them. Both are Flausch's champions, so we do the same.
They ban **Darius** (5×), **Sett** (4×) and **Sylas** (3×) themselves. Expect Sylas gone for Heino. If Darius or Sett are ever open, Kolbe takes them.

phase1.why: Their best answer to our Caitlyn + Nautilus/Leona lane: blocks Caitlyn's shots and Nautilus' hook. 2-0 for Lord Steve with this team.
Flausch's most played Prime League jungler (4-2) and 6-3 in solo queue. Also LEC Summer's most picked jungler.
Flausch's best solo queue champ (7-2). Banned against them in 8 of their 15 Prime League games.

phase2.why: Don's carry in their best comp: 2-0, going 16/2 and 13/2. Ban it if he hasn't picked yet.
Flausch's third jungler: 2-0 in Prime League, 5-1 in solo queue.
If Ruvex's top isn't out yet: 3-0 for him in Prime League.
Ruvex's most played Prime League top (3-2), 328k mastery.

bans.expect: Against us, teams banned Shaco (5×), Ekko, Katarina and LeBlanc (3× each). BS eSports bans Sylas often. Heino has Ahri, Qiyana and Sylas as backups.

roles.about: Diamond 4. Prime League: K'Sante 3-2, Ambessa 3-0, Ornn 2-1. Solo queue: Yone 9-2, Ambessa 3-6.

picks.why: Safe and comfortable (368k mastery). Subjugate deletes K'Sante's and Ornn's tankiness, the pillar stops Ambessa and Yone dashes. 67% WR in LEC Summer.
The safest blind pick. Holds the lane and his ult joins every bot or drake fight. LEC Summer staple (24 games, 58% WR).
Kolbe's highest mastery (1.18M). Tanky engage for the team; in lane against Ambessa or Yone just farm and wait for teamfights.
If the lane is free to win: LEC Summer's most picked top (36 games, 61% WR). AP damage that kites K'Sante and Ornn.

roles.tip: The goal is to neutralize the lane, not win it: Ruvex is Diamond 4 and Kolbe is off-role. Farm safely, keep TP for bot and drake fights, and pick last so you can counter. If Darius or Sett are open, take them: his team bans them often (Darius in 5 of 15 games, Sett in 4).

roles.about: Master 648 LP, their carry. Prime League: Jarvan IV 4-2, Xin Zhao 2-0, Vi 1-1, Wukong 1-1, Lee Sin 0-2. Solo queue: Elise 7-2, Jarvan IV 6-3, Xin Zhao 5-1.

picks.why: 3-0 for Smette in our Prime League games. Engage ult that chains with Nautilus, Leona and Shen.
Point-and-click engage on their immobile mid and ADC. High pro priority in LEC Summer (24 picks, 55 bans).
Engage plus a strong early 1v1; picking it also takes Flausch's third jungler away. LEC Spring's most picked jungler.
Smette's main right now (17 ranked games, 10 wins). Less engage, so only if the others are gone.

roles.tip: Don't 1v1 Flausch early, he's 1,000+ LP ahead. Ward your raptors/blue entrance by 1:15, ping where he starts, and play for mid and bot prio instead of invading.

roles.about: Diamond 2, their lowest rank. Prime League: Anivia 2-1, Viktor 1-2, Xerath, Diana, Ziggs, Veigar and Akali 1-0 each. Solo queue: Yasuo, Cassiopeia, Anivia.

picks.why: Heino's best right now (6 ranked games, 6 wins). Dashes onto immobile mages and dodges Anivia/Viktor CC. Often banned against us, so have a backup.
22/3/8 in our last Prime League game with her. Charm for catches, safe into everything.
Heino's third highest mastery (328k). Steals their Nautilus, Rell or Leona ult. BS eSports banned it in 3 of 15 games, so it may be gone.
All-in on immobile mages, pro-viable (picked in the LEC Summer playoffs). Backup if Ekko is banned.

roles.tip: Mid is where we can break them. Shove, then roam to bot river with HennenG. Smette's first gank comes mid.

roles.about: Master 640 LP. Prime League: Kalista 2-0, Ashe 2-0, Varus 2-4, Jinx 1-1, Kai'Sa 1-1. Mastery: Jinx 1.02M, Kalista 691k.

picks.why: Our win condition. EP's most played ADC; outranges Varus, Jinx and Kalista and bullies the lane with Nautilus or Leona.
Backup if Caitlyn is banned: long-range engage follow-up. Don's most played Prime League pick, so taking it also denies him.
Backup with Leona or Thresh: his W roots anyone our support just hit. 210k mastery.
Safe fallback if they ban our bot lane and draft heavy engage. Joint most picked ADC of the LEC Summer playoffs.

roles.tip: With Caitlyn, shove for level 2 first and let Nautilus/Leona go in when they walk up. If they hit level 2 first, back off: their bot pair are two Master players.

roles.about: Master 1,071 LP, the highest-ranked player in this game. Prime League: Nautilus 2-1, Nami 2-1, Braum 2-0, Lulu 1-1, Rell 0-2. Solo queue: Rell (14 of 30 games).

picks.why: 3-0 for HennenG in Prime League. Point-and-click engage on their immobile mid and ADC.
HennenG's most played (11 ranked games, 7 wins). Perfect with Caitlyn: stun into a free headshot. LEC Summer's most picked support.
Engage plus lantern saves; 3-1 in his recent ranked games. Backup if both are gone.

roles.tip: Play level 2 with Caitlyn's range. After the first back, roam mid with Heino: that's the other lane we win.

comps.name: Main plan
comps.sub: bot lane wins, engage jungle, safe top
comps.win: Caitlyn + Nautilus win lane and take drakes; Wukong and Ekko collapse on their immobile mid and ADC. Trundle holds top and joins with TP.
comps.why: The team's own call. Wukong 3-0 and Nautilus 3-0 in our Prime League games, Ekko 6-0 in ranked, Caitlyn is EP's most played ADC.
comps.risk: If their bot lane wins level 2, play safe until Smette arrives.

comps.name: Backup B
comps.win: Chain engage: Leona or Vi go in, Varus ult extends it, Ahri charms, Shen ults onto the fight.
comps.why: Same idea with different champions, if they ban Caitlyn or Ekko.
comps.risk: Varus and Ahri are often contested; needs EP comfortable on Varus.

comps.name: Backup C
comps.win: Thresh or Xin start the fight, Galio ults in, Sylas steals their engage ult, Jhin roots the stack.
comps.why: Kolbe's highest mastery champion and comfort picks around it.
comps.risk: Sylas is often banned by them; Jhin did poorly in pro play this year.

plan.fearless: The three comps share no champions: the backups also work for game 2 and 3 if this game day is a series with Fearless Draft.

blue: B2 + B3: Nautilus or Leona, plus Smette's engage jungler (Wukong, Vi or Xin Zhao).
Phase-2 bans: Kalista if still open, otherwise Ruvex's top (K'Sante / Ambessa) or Xin Zhao.
B4: Heino's fighting mid, countering their mid if it's out.
B5: Kolbe's safe top (Trundle, Shen or Galio).
red: R1 + R2: Caitlyn + Nautilus or Leona.
Phase-2 bans: Kalista if still open, otherwise Ruvex's top (K'Sante / Ambessa).
R5: Kolbe's safe top, last pick.

points: Bot lane is our win condition: Caitlyn shoves for level 2, Nautilus/Leona go in when they walk up. Smette paths toward bot early.
Ward our jungle entrances by 1:15. Flausch loves level-3 skirmishes.
First gank mid if bot doesn't need help: WoFu is their lowest-ranked player and plays immobile mages.
Kolbe holds TP for drake fights. No river fights without mid prio.
Their best comp (Ornn, Xin, Anivia, Kalista, Braum) won twice in under 30 minutes off early drakes. If they get prio, trade cross-map instead of flipping.
One shotcaller for objectives, short calls ("Flausch bot", "Flash mid down").
This is our window: their losses average 36 minutes. Group, ward Baron early, fight front-to-back.
Don't split Heino alone. Their jungle and support punish picks.

plan.oneLiner: Win bot with **Caitlyn + Nautilus/Leona**, take their jungler's champions away, fight with an engage jungler and a fighting mid, and let Kolbe play it safe top.
gist: **Bot is our win condition.** Caitlyn with Nautilus or Leona beats most of their bot champions. Braum is their best answer to it, so we ban it.
**Take Flausch's champions.** Their jungler is their best player: Jarvan IV and Elise go in phase 1.
**Gank mid first.** WoFu Ven is their lowest-ranked player and plays immobile mages, the perfect target for Smette and Heino.
**Top just has to hold.** Kolbe takes something safe he's comfortable on and picks last. They lose long games, so no early coin-flips.
